prompt: A door appears in your basement that wasn't there yesterday.

options.text: Brick it up and never speak of it

options.text: Leave a polite, well-formatted note

options.text: Quietly rescue it with spoons and dignity

options.text: Formal handwritten letters

options.text: Read every page, then wish for world peace

options.text: Build everyone a colour-coded itinerary

options.text: Hand it to the police, untouched

options.text: Your boss, to see how it really works

options.text: Cut it into two perfectly equal halves

options.text: Draw up house rules together

options.text: A classic costume, flawlessly made

options.text: First aid
